name: secondary-storage
reason: C: fell below the existing 10 GiB reserve. D: is a separate filesystem with approximately 75 GB free. All old C: scratch is terminal and absent. Select D: for new scratch and retained artifacts; do not bypass the C: capacity rejection or relocate pinned inputs.
initial_scope: Retain and inspect the failed Linux CI artifact without source, SDK, dependency or environment relocation. A Windows producer on D: needs a separate source/origin/proof-path audit before launch.
success_transport_scope: Retain one successful Linux native CI artifact by content hash, original receipts and licenses, with compressed-plus-expanded size checked before extraction. Schema inputs may be staged once by exact source hash for read-only proof validation. No source tree, SDK, environment or pinned origin relocation is authorized by this transport profile.
registry: Inherit every original C: protected and blocked absolute path and record the original registry path/hash. Admit only the fresh D: managed layout. Keep original rejection records at their existing C: origins. Never adopt or clean a legacy directory.
reuse: Read existing C: source, policy, tools and original licenses. Keep D: scratch at build/work/<run-id>, evidence at build/runs/<run-id> and artifacts at build/artifacts/<sha256>. No directory alias, recursive copy of build history, environment creation or dependency download.
terminal_cleanup: Wait for children, retain actual exit/wait and original artifact/source/license identities outside scratch, inspect a registry-aware cleanup plan, apply it and rehash retained files. No new experiment before terminal cleanup.
